<thought>Analyzing the 13C NMR data, the only peak in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm) is at 26.29 ppm, indicating a single CH₃ carbon. The other low‑field peaks correspond to carbonyl, aromatic, and aliphatic carbons, not methyls. Therefore, the molecule contains one methyl group.</thought>
